name: Naproxen
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: Naproxen 250 to 500 mg twice daily, or naproxen sodium 275 to 550 mg twice daily
Naproxen sodium 550 mg, then 550 mg every 12 hours or 275 mg every 6 to 8 hours as needed

key_interactions.effect: Less blood-pressure and diuretic effect; risk of acute kidney injury and hyperkalemia, especially in older, volume-depleted or CKD patients (label).
key_interactions.action: Avoid the triple combination where possible; if used, check creatinine and potassium within 1 to 2 weeks and keep the patient hydrated.
Avoid if possible; otherwise monitor for bleeding.

key_interactions.effect: More gastrointestinal toxicity without added benefit (label).

key_interactions.action: Monitor drug levels and kidney function.

serious: Acute kidney injury, papillary necrosis, hyperkalemia

contraindications: Asthma, urticaria or allergic-type reaction after aspirin or other NSAIDs
Setting of coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery
monitoring: Serum creatinine and potassium at baseline and during use in CKD, heart failure, cirrhosis, older adults, or with ACE inhibitors, ARBs or diuretics
Blood pressure; signs of gastrointestinal bleeding; hemoglobin if anemia symptoms

pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 95% in urine, mostly conjugates (under 1% unchanged)
